issue_context.title: Bug: Startup settings are not followed when opened via explorer
issue_context.body:
### Description

Typing File explorer or setting as default then opening file location using another program, startup settings are ignored.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Set Files as default
2. Set Start up to open a specific page
3. Close Files
4. Open File explorer from start menu or other program (Open file location)
5. See startup settings ignored

### Requirements

- Follow startup settings when opened from explorer call

### Files Version

2.4.58.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.1345

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/11103192/debug.log)
comments:
I believe this is not a problem; it is the intended behavior.
If an open location is specified, it should open that location regardless of the startup settings.

That doesn't make sense. If and open location is specified it should really open a new tab with it (This is what browsers do). It also makes continue where you left off quite useless as I have to open any tabs that were there before to come back to it later every time.

I see, so if the startup setting is not "Open a new tab", not only the specified location should be opened but also the same tab that would be opened if the location were not specified.
Is this correct?
Yeah start up settings are following just with the new tab that would be opened.
@Josh65-2201 a fix has been implemented and will be included in one of the next feature releases.
